finding.reason: Each already-running finite_owner_chain allocation ultimately launches the frozen legacy fallback command as an independent gpu_owner process. That process performs its own repeated admissible_work and claims.acquire cycle. Guarding only finite_dispatch.submit_with_admission therefore cannot prevent an existing allocation from reacquiring a run after that run is frozen for V5 handoff.
finding.rejected_claim: A guarded finite_dispatch daemon alone establishes exclusive V5 handoff safety.

before_arm: prove that the target run is excluded by the future-acquisition path of every still-live legacy gpu_owner allocation using an existing protocol-visible hold or exclusion
or wait for every allocation capable of reacquiring the target run to exit naturally, then verify its Slurm terminal state, process absence, claim release and journal state
only then arm the registry entry, freeze an immutable optimizer-boundary checkpoint and transfer the claim
must_not_rely_on: an assumed gap between legacy claim releases and reacquisition

ownership_boundary.required_change_location: MHD_Models finite_dispatch/finite_owner_chain control plane or the established legacy owner hold protocol
